rules.statement: An advocate should not withdraw from a case after an application for postponement has been refused, and must proceed with the trial using available evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: "The learned Judge also quoted with approval a passage from the judgment of Layard C. J. in Fernando v. Andiris [(1905) 2 A. C. R. 140. ] where the learned Chief Justice said : 'After the District Judge had refused to grant a postponement the plaintiff's proctor should have called such evidence as was available on behalf of the plaintiff, and should not have declined to call any evidence.'"
